question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as month_num,
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        COUNT(*) as delivered_orders
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018
    GROUP BY 
        CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER),
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT 
    month_num as month,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2016 THEN delivered_orders ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as year_2016,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN delivered_orders ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as year_2017,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN delivered_orders ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) as year_2018
FROM delivered_counts
GROUP BY month_num
ORDER BY month_num
